title: Answer review 1 in the study-capability M1 design

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/study-capability-m1.md answers every finding in review 1 (M1–M7, m1–m8, n1–n2): each is either changed in the design text or has a recorded reasoned decision not to change.

A response appendix, modelled on athena-v0.md Appendix D, maps each finding id to a disposition (accepted, changed in §x, deferred with reason, declined with reason); it is linked from the header and contents.

The review's eight user decisions (waivers, containment, run caps, judgment rules, model scope, observability, Pages design timing, alternatives) are each decided in the design with a stated reason, and none is left open or phrased as a question.
Evidence rules are non-waivable (M1); §5.4 covers commit, PR and run-id citations and requires a file source and a run source for `both`; `study.run/1` gains a sha field and the pin a tag field (M2).

The four judgment rules in §5.4 become structural checks or are relabeled verifier duties (M3); §5.1 states handling of or limits for multi-agent, fan-out, model-decided guards, unhandled failures and retry changes (M4).
The design states run-step containment, redaction before output is stored, which meter enforces the per-run cap, and run-record capture streams and the replay step (M5–M7).

The synthetic example is consistent on attempts versus requeues and the declared counter, and the retry-edge definition no longer relies on an undefined state order (m2). No claim about firstmate is added.
The status line no longer says findings are unanswered and states a re-check of the revised design is required before building under §9; the review file is unchanged.
Run `cargo test` and `cargo fmt --check` from the repository root; both pass, including xtask policy tests that may check docs links and anchors.

out_of_scope: Editing the review file or anything under records/
Building any of the study capability code
Changing governance files such as athena.toml or defaults.toml
departures: Cost nudged up slightly: a long design doc must answer 17 findings and all decisions must be made, not left open.
